d: Addressing Uttarakhand's state foundation day celebrations, Union Home Minister Amit Shah asserted that the Uniform Civil Code would soon be expanded across all states ruled by the Bharatiya Janata Party. Praising Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami's administration for pioneer implementation of the UCC, Shah noted that several other states are progressing towards enacting similar codes.
